summary.zh: 八个维度给公司整体健康度打分
summary.en: Score company health across eight dimensions with a traffic light.

description.zh: 从财务、营收、产品、工程、人力、运营、安全、市场八个维度给公司健康度打分，并用红黄绿标注风险。适合董事会评审前，或某个职能看起来出了问题需要整体体检时使用。评分脚本只依赖 Python 标准库。
description.en: Scores company health across finance, revenue, product, engineering, people, ops, security, and market with a traffic light. Use it before a board review or when a function looks at risk. The script needs only the Python standard library.
